cover_headline: Adani Enterprises Plans Rs 35,000-40,000 Crore Annual Capex Over Next Two Years
facts: Adani Enterprises plans capital expenditure of Rs 35,000 crore to Rs 40,000 crore a year over the next couple of years, its head of finance said on the earnings call
The company reported its highest-ever half-year EBITDA of Rs 11,958 crore for the six months ended September 2026, up 56 per cent, on consolidated income of Rs 71,569 crore, up 62 per cent
AdaniConneX has expanded its contracted data-centre capacity to more than 1.2 gigawatts, and Navi Mumbai airport is expected to reach 20 million passengers a year by the end of FY28

quote.text: We expect to do capex at a run rate of around Rs 40,000 crore. So, we may be somewhere in the range of Rs 35,000 crore to Rs 40,000 crore, which is the rate we expect to continue over the next couple of years.
quote.speaker: Manan Vakharia

end.headline: Adani Enterprises Plans Rs 35,000-40,000 Crore Annual Capex Over Next Two Years
end.line: Airports, data centres and the Mundra PVC complex will lead Adani Enterprises' Rs 35,000-40,000 crore annual capex, after record first-half EBITDA of Rs 11,958 crore.
